settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: What the app runs with now, read from its configuration. Read-only: a change needs a new value for the variable and a restart. Secrets are never shown.

runtime.title: Spending limits you can change
runtime.lede: Change these limits without a deploy. The app applies the new value at once and records who changed what and why.

hosts.title: Discovery hosts
hosts.lede: Sites discovery knows by name. A post on a writing site is proposed as an article; a page on a directory is never kept. The next discovery run uses your change.
hosts.empty: Enter a host name, such as techcrunch.com.
hosts.failed: The action failed. Please try again.
hosts.loadError: Could not load the discovery hosts.

removeEffect.WRITING: Its posts are then proposed only when their address looks like a post.
removeEffect.DIRECTORY: Its pages can then be proposed as products.

enrichment.title: Enrichment queue

lede.WAITING: What the Scout enriches next, in its order: the ones you moved to the top first, then never-run resources, then the ones to try again, newest first. An action changes the order only: the daily enrichment limit stays the same.
lede.SKIPPED: The resources you skipped, the latest first. The Scout does not take them until you requeue them.
lede.OUT_OF_RETRIES: The resources whose runs failed too many times. The Scout does not try them again until you requeue them.

empty.OUT_OF_RETRIES: No resource is out of retries.

enrichment.loadError: Could not load the enrichment queue.

done.prioritise: “{{title}}” is at the top. The Scout takes it in its next run, within the daily limit.
done.skip: “{{title}}” is skipped. Find it under Skipped to requeue it.
done.requeue: “{{title}}” is back in the queue, in its own place.

enrichment.failed: The action failed. Nothing changed. Try again.
